question_de: Wie hoch war der tatsächlich erzielte Netto-Umsatz der letzten 90 Tage bis zum Stichtag, wenn man Retouren korrekt berücksichtigt?
gold_sql:
SELECT
      SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate))
        - COALESCE((
            SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount)
            FROM ecom_v1.returns r
            JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi2 ON oi2.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
            JOIN ecom_v1.orders o2 ON o2.order_id = oi2.order_id
            WHERE o2.order_status != 'cancelled'
              AND o2.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'
          ), 0) AS net_revenue
    FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
    JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
      AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'

question_de: Welche fünf Produktkategorien hatten im Jahr 2025 den höchsten Netto-Umsatz? Gib Kategorienamen und Netto-Umsatz aus, absteigend sortiert.
gold_sql:
SELECT cat.category_name,
           SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
    FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
    JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id

question_de: Wie hat sich der monatliche Netto-Umsatz im ersten Halbjahr 2026 gegenüber dem ersten Halbjahr 2025 entwickelt, wenn man Retouren korrekt berücksichtigt? Gib je Zeile die Periode ('current' bzw. 'previous'), den Monat als Jahr-Monat und den Netto-Umsatz aus.
gold_sql:
WITH monthly_net AS (
      SELECT
        FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS year_month,
        CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 'current'
             WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN 'previous'
        END AS period,
        SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS gross_net
      FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
      JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
      WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
        AND (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
             OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30')
      GROUP BY year_month, period
    ),
    returns_by_month AS (
      SELECT
        FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS year_month,
        SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refunds
      FROM ecom_v1.returns r
      JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
      JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
      WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
        AND (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
             OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30')
      GROUP BY year_month
    )
    SELECT m.period, m.year_month,
           m.gross_net - COALESCE(r.refunds, 0) AS net_revenue
    FROM monthly_net m
    LEFT JOIN returns_by_month r ON r.year_month = m.year_month
    ORDER BY m.period, m.year_month

question_de: Wie hat sich die kumulierte Anzahl an Bestellungen über das Jahr 2025 entwickelt? Gib je Monat den Jahr-Monat, die Bestellungen des Monats und die laufende Summe aus.
gold_sql:
WITH monthly_orders AS (
      SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', order_date) AS year_month, COUNT(*) AS order_count
      FROM ecom_v1.orders
      WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
      GROUP BY year_month
    )
    SELECT
      year_month,
      order_count,
      SUM(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY year_month) AS running_total
    FROM monthly_orders
    ORDER BY year_month

question_de: Welche Hauptkategorien haben im ersten Halbjahr 2026 einen höheren Deckungsbeitrag erzielt als im ersten Halbjahr 2025? Gib Kategorienamen, Deckungsbeitrag beider Perioden und die Veränderung aus, absteigend nach Veränderung.
gold_sql:
WITH main_cat AS (
      SELECT category_id, COALESCE(parent_category_id, category_id) AS main_category_id
      FROM ecom_v1.categories
    ),
    margin_by_period AS (
      SELECT
        mc.main_category_id,
        CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 'current'
             ELSE 'previous' END AS period,
        SUM(
          (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
          - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
          - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
                 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
                 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS contribution_margin
      FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
      JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
      JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
      JOIN main_cat mc ON mc.category_id = p.category_id
      JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
      WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
        AND (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
             OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30')
      GROUP BY mc.main_category_id, period
    )
    SELECT c.category_name,
           cur.contribution_margin AS current_margin,
           prev.contribution_margin AS previous_margin,
           cur.contribution_margin - prev.contribution_margin AS margin_change
    FROM margin_by_period cur
    JOIN margin_by_period prev ON prev.main_category_id = cur.main_category_id AND prev.period = 'previous'
    JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON c.category_id = cur.main_category_id
    WHERE cur.period = 'current'
      AND cur.contribution_margin > prev.contribution_margin
    ORDER BY margin_change DESC

question_de: Welche zehn Kunden gehören laut Netto-Umsatz zu den Top 10 %, haben aber trotzdem den niedrigsten Deckungsbeitrag unter diesen Top-Kunden? Gib Kunden-ID, Netto-Umsatz und Deckungsbeitrag aus, aufsteigend nach Deckungsbeitrag.
gold_sql:
WITH customer_net AS (
      SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
      FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
      JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
      WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
      GROUP BY o.customer_id
    ),
    customer_margin AS (
      SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        SUM(
          (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
          - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
          - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
                 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
                 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS contribution_margin
      FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
      JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
      JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
      JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
      WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
      GROUP BY o.customer_id
    ),
    ranked AS (
      SELECT customer_id, net_revenue,
             PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_revenue DESC) AS pct_rank
      FROM customer_net
    )
    SELECT r.customer_id, r.net_revenue, m.contribution_margin
    FROM ranked r
    JOIN customer_margin m ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id
    WHERE r.pct_rank <= 0.10
    ORDER BY m.contribution_margin ASC
    LIMIT 10

question_de: Wie viele Bestellungen gab es je Quartal in den Jahren 2024 und 2025, und wie stark ist das Quartal gegenüber dem Vorquartal gewachsen? Gib Jahr, Quartal, Bestellanzahl und die Veränderung zum Vorquartal aus.
gold_sql:
WITH quarterly AS (
      SELECT
        d.year, d.quarter,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
      FROM ecom_v1.orders o
      JOIN ecom_v1.dim_date d ON d.date_key = o.order_date
      WHERE d.year IN (2024, 2025)
      GROUP BY d.year, d.quarter
    )
    SELECT
      year, quarter, order_count,
      order_count - LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY year, quarter) AS qoq_change
    FROM quarterly
    ORDER BY year, quarter

question_de: Welche Produkte haben eine Retourenquote (Anteil zurückgegebener Menge an verkaufter Menge) von über 20 %, obwohl sie nicht eingestellt wurden? Gib Produkt-ID, verkaufte Menge, zurückgegebene Menge und Retourenquote aus, absteigend nach Quote.
gold_sql:
WITH sold AS (
      SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty_sold
      FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
      JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
      WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
      GROUP BY oi.product_id
    ),
    returned AS (
      SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS qty_returned
      FROM ecom_v1.returns r
      JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
      GROUP BY oi.product_id
    )
    SELECT s.product_id, s.qty_sold, COALESCE(ret.qty_returned, 0) AS qty_returned,
           COALESCE(ret.qty_returned, 0) / s.qty_sold AS return_rate
    FROM sold s
    LEFT JOIN returned ret ON ret.product_id = s.product_id
    JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = s.product_id
    WHERE p.discontinued_on IS NULL
      AND COALESCE(ret.qty_returned, 0) / s.qty_sold > 0.20
    ORDER BY return_rate DESC

question_de: Welche Hauptkategorie hatte 2024 den niedrigsten Netto-Umsatz? Gib Kategorienamen und Netto-Umsatz aus.
gold_sql:
WITH main_cat AS (
      SELECT category_id, COALESCE(parent_category_id, category_id) AS main_category_id
      FROM ecom_v1.categories
    )
    SELECT c.category_name,
           SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
    FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
    JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    JOIN main_cat mc ON mc.category_id = p.category_id
    JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON c.category_id = mc.main_category_id
    WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
      AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
    GROUP BY c.category_name
    ORDER BY net_revenue ASC
    LIMIT 1

question_de: Welche drei Produkte hatten das stärkste Umsatzwachstum (nach Bruttowert) vom zweiten Halbjahr 2025 zum ersten Halbjahr 2026? Gib Produkt-ID, Bruttowert beider Perioden und das Wachstum aus, absteigend nach Wachstum.
gold_sql:
WITH gross_by_period AS (
      SELECT
        oi.product_id,
        CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 'current'
             WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' THEN 'previous'
        END AS period,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross) AS gross_revenue
      FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
      JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
      WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
        AND (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
             OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31')
      GROUP BY oi.product_id, period
    )
    SELECT cur.product_id,
           cur.gross_revenue AS current_revenue,
           COALESCE(prev.gross_revenue, 0) AS previous_revenue,
           cur.gross_revenue - COALESCE(prev.gross_revenue, 0) AS growth
    FROM gross_by_period cur
    LEFT JOIN gross_by_period prev ON prev.product_id = cur.product_id AND prev.period = 'previous'
    WHERE cur.period = 'current'
    ORDER BY growth DESC
    LIMIT 3

question_de: Wie hat sich die Anzahl gelöschter Kundenkonten über die Zeit kumulativ entwickelt? Gib je Monat den Jahr-Monat, die Löschungen des Monats und die kumulierte Anzahl aus.
gold_sql:
WITH monthly_deletions AS (
      SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', deleted_at) AS year_month, COUNT(*) AS deletions
      FROM ecom_v1.customers
      WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY year_month
    )
    SELECT
      year_month,
      deletions,
      SUM(deletions) OVER (ORDER BY year_month) AS cumulative_deletions
    FROM monthly_deletions
    ORDER BY year_month

question_de: Welche Produkte liegen bei der Retourenquote (Menge zurückgegeben / Menge verkauft) über dem Durchschnitt ihrer eigenen Hauptkategorie? Gib Produkt-ID, die Retourenquote des Produkts und den Durchschnitt der Hauptkategorie aus, absteigend nach Produktquote.
gold_sql:
WITH main_cat AS (
      SELECT category_id, COALESCE(parent_category_id, category_id) AS main_category_id
      FROM ecom_v1.categories
    ),
    sold AS (
      SELECT oi.product_id, p.category_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty_sold
      FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
      JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
      JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
      WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
      GROUP BY oi.product_id, p.category_id
    ),
    returned AS (
      SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS qty_returned
      FROM ecom_v1.returns r
      JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
      GROUP BY oi.product_id
    ),
    product_rate AS (
      SELECT s.product_id, mc.main_category_id,
             COALESCE(ret.qty_returned, 0) / s.qty_sold AS return_rate
      FROM sold s
      JOIN main_cat mc ON mc.category_id = s.category_id
      LEFT JOIN returned ret ON ret.product_id = s.product_id
    ),
    category_avg AS (
      SELECT main_category_id, AVG(return_rate) AS avg_return_rate
      FROM product_rate
      GROUP BY main_category_id
    )
    SELECT pr.product_id, pr.return_rate, ca.avg_return_rate
    FROM product_rate pr
    JOIN category_avg ca ON ca.main_category_id = pr.main_category_id
    WHERE pr.return_rate > ca.avg_return_rate
    ORDER BY pr.return_rate DESC

question_de: Welche Kunden waren vor 90 Tagen noch aktiv, sind es aber jetzt nicht mehr (in den letzten 90 Tagen bis zum Stichtag)?
gold_sql:
WITH earlier_active AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id
      FROM ecom_v1.orders o
      WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
        AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 180 DAY)
                             AND DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 91 DAY)
    ),
    currently_active AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id
      FROM ecom_v1.orders o
      WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
        AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'
    )
    SELECT e.customer_id
    FROM earlier_active e

question_de: Welche Produktkategorie hat bei unseren aktiven Kunden im Jahr 2025 laut Hausdefinition den höchsten tatsächlichen Umsatz nach allen Abzügen erzielt? Gib Kategorienamen und diesen Umsatz aus.
gold_sql:
WITH active_customers AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
      FROM ecom_v1.customers c
      JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
      WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
        AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'
        AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
    ),
    net_by_category AS (
      SELECT cat.category_name,
             SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS gross_net
      FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
      JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
      JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
      JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
      WHERE o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM active_customers)
        AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'
        AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
      GROUP BY cat.category_name
    ),
    returns_by_category AS (
      SELECT cat.category_name, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refunds
      FROM ecom_v1.returns r
      JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
      JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
      JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
      JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
      WHERE o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM active_customers)
        AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'
        AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
      GROUP BY cat.category_name
    )
    SELECT n.category_name, n.gross_net - COALESCE(r.refunds, 0) AS net_revenue
    FROM net_by_category n
    LEFT JOIN returns_by_category r ON r.category_name = n.category_name
    ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
    LIMIT 1

question_de: Wo ist unser Rohertrag nach Wareneinsatz und Provision je Hauptkategorie im ersten Halbjahr 2026 gegenüber dem Vorjahreszeitraum gestiegen? Gib Kategorienamen, Rohertrag beider Perioden und die Veränderung aus, absteigend nach Veränderung.
gold_sql:
WITH main_cat AS (
      SELECT category_id, COALESCE(parent_category_id, category_id) AS main_category_id
      FROM ecom_v1.categories
    ),
    margin_by_period AS (
      SELECT
        mc.main_category_id,
        CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 'current'
             ELSE 'previous' END AS period,
        SUM(
          (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
          - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
          - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
                 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
                 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS contribution_margin
      FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
      JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
      JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
      JOIN main_cat mc ON mc.category_id = p.category_id
      JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
      WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
        AND (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
             OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30')
      GROUP BY mc.main_category_id, period
    )
    SELECT c.category_name,
           cur.contribution_margin AS current_margin,
           prev.contribution_margin AS previous_margin,
           cur.contribution_margin - prev.contribution_margin AS margin_change
    FROM margin_by_period cur
    JOIN margin_by_period prev ON prev.main_category_id = cur.main_category_id AND prev.period = 'previous'
    JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON c.category_id = cur.main_category_id
    WHERE cur.period = 'current'
      AND cur.contribution_margin > prev.contribution_margin
    ORDER BY margin_change DESC

question_de: Welche zehn Kunden zählen laut Netto-Umsatz zu unseren Top-Kunden (oberste 10 %), tragen aber unter diesen den geringsten Rohertrag nach Wareneinsatz und Provision bei? Gib Kunden-ID, Netto-Umsatz und Rohertrag aus, aufsteigend nach Rohertrag.
gold_sql:
WITH customer_net AS (
      SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
      FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
      JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
      WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
      GROUP BY o.customer_id
    ),
    customer_margin AS (
      SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        SUM(
          (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
          - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
          - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
                 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
                 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS contribution_margin
      FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
      JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
      JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
      JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
      WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
      GROUP BY o.customer_id
    ),
    ranked AS (
      SELECT customer_id, net_revenue,
             PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_revenue DESC) AS pct_rank
      FROM customer_net
    )
    SELECT r.customer_id, r.net_revenue, m.contribution_margin
    FROM ranked r
    JOIN customer_margin m ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id
    WHERE r.pct_rank <= 0.10
    ORDER BY m.contribution_margin ASC
    LIMIT 10

question_de: Wie hat sich der Anteil unserer treuen Stammkunden (Wiederkäufer) am tatsächlich erzielten Umsatz von 2024 zu 2025 verändert? Gib je Jahr das Jahr und den Umsatzanteil der Wiederkäufer aus.
gold_sql:
WITH repeat_customers_by_year AS (
      SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS yr, customer_id
      FROM ecom_v1.orders
      WHERE order_status != 'cancelled'
        AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) IN (2024, 2025)
      GROUP BY yr, customer_id
      HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', order_date)) >= 2
    ),
    net_by_year AS (
      SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS yr,
        o.customer_id,
        SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
      FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
      JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
      WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
        AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) IN (2024, 2025)
      GROUP BY yr, o.customer_id
    )
    SELECT
      n.yr,
      SUM(CASE WHEN r.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN n.net_revenue ELSE 0 END) / SUM(n.net_revenue) AS repeat_customer_revenue_share
    FROM net_by_year n
    LEFT JOIN repeat_customers_by_year r ON r.yr = n.yr AND r.customer_id = n.customer_id
    GROUP BY n.yr
    ORDER BY n.yr

question_de: Welche Hauptkategorien tragen laut Rohertrag nach Wareneinsatz und Provision überdurchschnittlich zum Geschäftsergebnis bei, wenn man Retouren korrekt berücksichtigt? Gib Kategorienamen und Rohertrag aus, absteigend sortiert.
gold_sql:
WITH main_cat AS (
      SELECT category_id, COALESCE(parent_category_id, category_id) AS main_category_id
      FROM ecom_v1.categories
    ),
    item_margin AS (
      SELECT
        oi.order_item_id,
        mc.main_category_id,
        (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
          - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
          - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
                 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
                 ELSE 0 END AS margin_before_returns
      FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
      JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
      JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
      JOIN main_cat mc ON mc.category_id = p.category_id
      JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
      WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    ),
    returns_by_item AS (
      SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refunds
      FROM ecom_v1.returns
      GROUP BY order_item_id
    ),
    margin_by_category AS (
      SELECT
        im.main_category_id,
        SUM(im.margin_before_returns - COALESCE(r.refunds, 0)) AS contribution_margin
      FROM item_margin im
      LEFT JOIN returns_by_item r ON r.order_item_id = im.order_item_id
      GROUP BY im.main_category_id
    )
    SELECT c.category_name, m.contribution_margin
    FROM margin_by_category m
    JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON c.category_id = m.main_category_id
    WHERE m.contribution_margin > (SELECT AVG(contribution_margin) FROM margin_by_category)
    ORDER BY m.contribution_margin DESC
